result.markdown:
If you mean **Newcastle, NSW**, I’d shortlist these firms. I’m weighting **workers-compensation expertise, independent rankings, specialist accreditation, and local presence** rather than simply Google reviews.

### My top picks

1. **Turner Freeman Lawyers Newcastle — my first choice**
   - Turner Freeman is **First Tier** in Doyle’s 2026 NSW ranking for plaintiff work-injury compensation firms. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Their Newcastle team specifically handles workers compensation and work-injury-damages claims.
   - **Ben Grosse**, a Newcastle partner, is an **Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law** and regularly represents injured workers in the Personal Injury Commission and courts. [www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/team/ben-grosse/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - They also have several Newcastle lawyers focused on workers compensation. [www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/team/matt-sage/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Local address: 3/384 Hunter St, Newcastle.

2. **Law Partners Injury Lawyers Newcastle — excellent alternative**
   - Law Partners is also **First Tier** in Doyle’s 2026 NSW plaintiff work-injury ranking. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Their Newcastle office has lawyers specifically practising workers compensation. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/workers-compensation-lawyers-newcastle?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Gillian Potts** is an **Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law**, based in Newcastle, and specialises in workers compensation among other personal-injury areas. [www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/team/matt-sage/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/our-team/gillian-potts?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/offices/newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/team/ben-grosse/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Local office: Level 5, 400 Hunter St.

3. **Carroll & O'Dea Lawyers — strong specialist firm**
   - Carroll & O’Dea is **First Tier** in Doyle’s 2026 NSW work-injury ranking. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - They have a Newcastle office and a long-established personal-injury practice.
   - Particularly worth considering for a **more complicated or serious workplace injury**.

4. **Burke Mead Lawyers - Newcastle — good local option**
   - Newcastle-based firm with a dedicated practice covering **workers compensation and personal injury** throughout the Hunter region. [www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/offices/newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Doyle’s places Burke Mead in its **Third Tier** of NSW plaintiff work-injury firms for 2026. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Its Newcastle office currently has a strong 4.8/5 rating from 93 Google reviews.

5. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers — established national option**
   - Doyle’s 2026 ranking places Slater & Gordon in the **Third Tier** for NSW plaintiff work-injury firms. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - They have a Newcastle office and substantial workers-compensation infrastructure.

### If it were my case

I'd **speak to Turner Freeman and Law Partners first**, then compare their advice and fee agreements. The strongest individual combination I found is **Ben Grosse at Turner Freeman** and **Gillian Potts at Law Partners**: both are Newcastle-based, experienced in personal injury, and have the Accredited Specialist credential. [www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/team/matt-sage/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/our-team/gillian-potts?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/offices/newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/team/ben-grosse/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **“best” depends heavily on the type of claim**. A straightforward workers-comp claim is quite different from a serious permanent injury, psychological injury, denied claim, work-injury-damages claim, or coal-mining injury.

If you tell me **what happened to you (e.g. back injury, psychological injury, machinery accident, repetitive injury), whether the insurer has accepted the claim, and roughly when it happened**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Newcastle lawyers I’d actually contact** and compare their fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements.
